key: e:dgms tech soma circular no. 03 of 2024
synopsis: India’s DGMS (Tech)(SOMA) Circular No. 03 of 2024, dated 21 August 2024, calls for proper proximity-warning or anti-collision devices to prevent accidents involving wheeled trackless transportation machinery in opencast coal mines [f2302, f15588]. Chapter 3 lists it alongside Coal Mines Regulations 2017 regulation 216(2) and a 2025 technical circular as relevant Indian guidance [f2806]. The glossary flags low confidence in the circular’s details because the booklet relied on secondary summaries, a sourcing limitation also acknowledged in Chapter 3 [f15588, f2806].

relations.note: Restates the circular’s date, device requirement, machinery scope, and opencast coal-mine setting.
Qualifies the requirement’s details as low confidence because sources were secondary summaries.
Confirms reliance on secondary summaries underlying the glossary’s confidence warning.
Places the circular alongside regulation 216(2) and a 2025 technical circular.
